You are an expert Vue 3 + Element Plus UI developer. Your task is to optimize the login page UI of SkillVault.

**File to modify (only this file):**
`frontend/src/views/LoginView.vue`

**Allowed changes:**
- Modify the `<template>` section (HTML structure and Element Plus component usage)
- Modify the `<style scoped>` section (CSS styles scoped to this component)
- You may add/modify CSS variables, flex/grid layouts, gradients, shadows, transitions, responsive breakpoints, and icon usage (Element Plus icons or inline SVGs)
- You may add/modify Element Plus component attributes (e.g., `:model`, `size`, `type`, `placeholder`, `prefix-icon`, `show-password`, `loading`, etc.)
- You may add a background container, card wrapper, or decorative elements (e.g., logo area, brand text, subtle background pattern/gradient)
- You may adjust the layout to be centered, full-viewport, with a card-based login form

**Forbidden changes:**
- Do NOT modify any JavaScript/TypeScript logic in `<script>` or `<script setup>` (including login API calls, form validation, i18n usage, router push, auth store, etc.)
- Do NOT modify any other files (no routing, no store, no i18n keys, no backend, no other compon
